title: Customize_Toolbars toolbar config
description: One toolbars/<id>.json file = one Harmony toolbar + its Windows-menu group + assignable shortcuts.

id.description: Stable slug for this toolbar; lower-cased and non-alphanumerics collapsed to '_' when ids are minted.

abbr.description: 1–3 letters shown on the leading title button (the toolbar's badge). Default: first 3 chars of `id`.

iconFallback.description: monogram = generate a letter badge for buttons with no icon; none = leave them to Harmony's placeholder.

menu.description: Opt-in: parent menu for a toggle + item group, e.g. "Windows". Omit / null = toolbar only (the default).

shortcutCategory.description: Category shown in Preferences ▸ Shortcuts. Defaults to `title`.

titleButton.description: Leading icon button that names the toolbar (EL_code titleAction style). true = default info button; false = off.

onClick.description: info = MessageBox listing the toolbar's items; menu = same listing (Harmony has no reliable pop-menu call); none = inert.

entry.description: function to launch; default = script basename

shortcut.description: Suggested key, surfaced in the shortcut description. Harmony assigns the actual key in Preferences.

companions.description: Extra file globs bundled into scripts/ by customize_toolbars_builder (ignored by the engine at runtime).
